params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, object below is the name of the form object (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: horizontal
params.description: Visibility of horizontal scrollbar Pass a Boolean variable to get the current displayed/hidden state, or a Longint variable to get the defined visibility mode (0=hidden, 1=displayed, 2=automatic).

sentinelValues.meaning: Scrollbar set to automatic mode; Boolean reflects the current display state, Integer literally returns 2.

params.name: vertical
params.description: Visibility of vertical scrollbar Pass a Boolean variable to get the current displayed/hidden state, or a Longint variable to get the defined visibility mode (0=hidden, 1=displayed, 2=automatic).

sentinelValues.meaning: Scrollbar set to automatic mode; Boolean reflects the current display state, Integer literally returns 2.

overloads.semanticRole: The OBJECT GET SCROLLBAR command is used to find out the displayed/hidden status of the horizontal and vertical scrollbars of the object or group of objects designated by object .
